text: Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, and standard_value for activities in assay CHEMBL1613914. Return exact activity values only. Source: compound_structures, molecule_dictionary, activities, assays. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno; activities to assays on assay_id; activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613914' and activities.standard_relation = '='. No deduplication.
